description: Kept for older clients; it claims nothing on a default registry. A reward on locked units is not claimed: where a registry pays one, its distributor pays it automatically, and this route answers 404 (403 where the reward switch `staking_rewards_enabled` is off, as on the public network). Requires agent JWT.

idempotency_key.description: reuse it on a retry: the route answers the first result again for 24 h instead of moving units twice (namespaced to the caller before it is sent)

position_id.description: Optional position id to target one position

name: theprotocol_claimStakingRewards
title: Claim Staking Rewards
